### **Solutions For Every Industry**

GBM has the track record of success in reducing IT time, improving document workflow and reducing costs in many different vertical markets.

![](https://goldenbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/healthcare.png)

#### Healthcare

#### Solutions For Healthcare

Few industries are undergoing as many challenges as healthcare. Rising costs and new legislation are forcing providers to find new ways to be more efficient and profitable while providing a higher quality of care.

Canon devices and software solutions support providers with solutions that can enable them to remain focused on what matters most – improving quality of care and patient safety.

![](https://goldenbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/worker.png)

#### Manufacturing

#### Solutions For Manufacturing

Manufacturers are finding that to be competitive and drive new products to market, they must have practices in place that can help limit access their trade secrets and intellectual documents, increase cooperation and collaboration in sharing of information and look for better ways to help reduce waste.  GBM offers solutions that can help Manufacturers combine Lean Document Processes with imaging technology to help address these emerging challenges.

![](https://goldenbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/government.png)

#### Government

#### Solutions For Government

GBM and Canon USA provide Federal, State and Local governments a complete portfolio of imaging solutions and software offerings. From our black & white and color multifunction devices to production center and large format solutions, we are uniquely positioned to ensure successful, consistent and secure implementation across your agency.

![](https://goldenbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/presentation.png)

#### Education

#### Solutions For Education

Educators in Higher Education and K12 face many challenges including increasing productivity and efficiency even as budgets are cut, safeguarding confidential student information, creating engaging course materials and more.

Canon devices and software solutions supports educators with solutions that can enable them to remain focused on what matters most, helping the next generation of students succeed.

![](https://goldenbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/legal.png)

#### Legal

#### Solutions For Legal

From discovery to pleadings, as a legal professional, you likely deal with paper documents every day.

You must store, manage, and reproduce them efficiently; helping control access to client’s confidential information remains secure.

GBM provides the tools, including Multifunction Copiers, Workflow and Document Management, along with the technical expertise to help your firm be more productive.

![](https://goldenbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/bank-1.png)

#### Non Profit

#### Are you a Non-Profit?

GBM and many of our technology partners have teamed up to provide substantial discounts for 501(c)(3) certified non-profits.  We work closely with non-profit’s to identify the technology products and services to help their organization prosper.

GBM provides expert technical support services at our special non-profit rate so that we can manage your computers and network, and you can concentrate on your organization’s mission.

### We offer workflow solutions to help businesses thrive. Get a free on-site consultation.

[Contact Us](https://goldenbusiness.com/contact/)

### GBM makes office printing and IT easy

GBM simplifies your workflow processes, document management and printing needs through best-in-class technology and award-winning service.

![](https://goldenbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/Untitled-design-1.png)

#### Reduce Printing Costs

Reduce your printing costs with our print tracking and control solutions. You’ll get a clear idea of how much you spend and where you can save.

![](https://goldenbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/Copy-of-Untitled-4.png)

#### Improve Data Security

Your data is secure with GBM. Our tailored solutions protect your most valuable assets against network intrusion and data theft.

![](https://goldenbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/Copy-of-Untitled-3.png)

#### One-Stop Shop for Tech

At GBM, our motto is: “Problem Solved.” Our comprehensive services meet the needs of any office, no matter the size or tech need — from managed IT services and ongoing maintenance to customized planning and network support.

![](https://goldenbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/Copy-of-Untitled-5.png)

#### Customer Support

We know your time is money. That’s why we offer real-time monitoring to catch printing problems as they happen — before they slow down your office workflow. Our technicians will be on-site in 4 hours or less, guaranteed.

[![](https://goldenbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/GBM_Master_logo_485CV.png)](https://goldenbusiness.com/)
